info.name: Vision Mart API
info.description:
Complete REST API for the Vision Mart eyewear e-commerce backend.

**Setup**
1. Set `base_url` (defaults to http://localhost:5000).
2. Run **Admin Auth > Admin Login** and **Customer Auth > Login** first — both auto-save their tokens into collection variables, so every other request is ready to go.

Seeded credentials: `admin@visionmart.com / AdminPass123` and `john@example.com / Password123`.

request.description: Accepts either a customer or an admin token. Returns is_admin.
Fails with 400 if products are still assigned to this category.
sort: newest | oldest | price_low | price_high | popularity | rating | name_asc | name_desc
Distinct brands/colors/frame types + price range, for building filter UI.
Send a customer token to get is_in_cart / is_in_wishlist flags.
Send discount_price as an empty string to clear an existing discount.
Re-adding an existing product increments its quantity.
Route param is the PRODUCT id, not the cart_item id.
Idempotent: re-adding returns 200 with meta.already_existed = true.
Omit `items` to buy the whole cart; the cart is cleared on success.
Customers can cancel while Pending/Confirmed. Restores stock.
Pending > Confirmed > Packed > Shipped > Out for Delivery > Delivered. Cancelled from any non-delivered state. Forward only.
Only cancelled orders can be deleted.
Opening an unread message marks it read.
